title: Exact fast factorizations of the AR(1) Karhunen-Loeve transform
summary: We derive a fast factorization of the exact Karhunen--Loève transform (KLT) of an AR(1) source by mapping it onto the Discrete Cosine Transform. For even $N$ and every $ρ\in(0,1)$, the KLT factors exactly into Chen's fast DCT-II structure---butterfly plus fixed half-size DCT-II and DCT-IV cores---completed by two orthogonal corrections: eigenvector matrices of diagonal-plus-rank-one matrices carrying the entire $ρ$-dependence.
